'''Isaac''' was a [[Duros]] who was the son of his [[parent|mother]] [[Arin]] and the [[bounty hunter]] [[Cad Bane]], though he was raised by Arin and his adoptive father—and Bane's former friend—[[Niro]].<ref name="OneGoodDeed" />

==Biography==
[[Reproduction|Born]] during [[Cad Bane|Bane]]'s time in [[prison]], Isaac was raised by his mother [[Arin]] and Bane's old friend [[Niro]]. However, Arin would eventually [[Death|die]], leaving Niro to raise Isaac alone as his own.<ref name="OneGoodDeed" />

Years passed, during which Niro rose to become the [[marshal]] of the [[city]] and Isaac would often visit him during work. However, Bane was eventually released from [[prison]] and returned to confront Niro. Though Niro ordered Isaac to return home while he confronted Bane, Isaac ran back just in time to witness the two facing off. As Bane's [[sniper]]s took out Niro's [[security droid]]s, he shielded Isaac as Bane closed in. Isaac watched as Niro stepped out into the street to engage in a stand off with his former friend. Bane would emerge victorious, shooting Niro in the chest and [[Death|killing]] him. As Isaac mourned his dying father, Bane approached his biological son and snarled that Niro had taken everything from him, only for Niro to reveal "Not everything". This revelation caused Bane to realize that Isaac was actually Bane's biological son, and seemed to express remorse for showing Isaac the monster he turned out to be before departing, leaving Isaac to be comforted by the [[Unidentified mayor|mayor]].<ref name="OneGoodDeed" />

{{Char-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
Isaac appeared in "[[One Good Deed]]," the sixth episode of the [[2025]] [[Disney+]] series ''[[Star Wars: Tales of the Underworld]]'', which premiered on [[May 4]], [[2025]].<ref name="Announcement">{{SW|url=news/tales-of-the-underworld-announce|text=Two Favorite ''Star Wars'' Bounty Hunters are Back for ''Tales of the Underworld''}}</ref> He was voiced by [[Idris Keith]].<ref name="OneGoodDeed" />
